title: Update sidebar navigation and landing panel link
description:
Modify two existing files to integrate the Define page into the dashboard navigation:

**1. `dashboard/frontend/components/layout/sidebar.tsx`**
Add a 'Define' nav item that links to `/define`. Place it logically near the existing 'Spec Alignment' entry. Keep 'Spec Alignment' as a separate entry (it's a drill-down from Define's Built column, not a replacement).

**2. `dashboard/frontend/components/layout/header.tsx`**
Add a view entry for the Define page so the header shows 'Define' when on the `/define` route. Follow the existing pattern for other pages.

Note: DefinePanel.tsx was already updated in task 7 to extract VisionWarning. The SurfaceLink href change from `/spec-alignment` to `/define` should also be done in task 7 since that task already touches DefinePanel.tsx. If task 7 did not make this change, add it here as a separate modification to DefinePanel.tsx.

Actually, re-checking: task 7 touches DefinePanel.tsx for VisionWarning extraction. The SurfaceLink href update (`/spec-alignment` → `/define`) should be included in task 7 to avoid a second task touching the same file. Record as assumption.
acceptance_criteria:
- Sidebar shows 'Define' nav item linking to /define
- 'Spec Alignment' entry remains in sidebar
- Header displays 'Define' when on /define route
- Navigation to /define works from sidebar click
- No type errors in modified files
